messages.subject: International Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Galati,

Bedford Group's mining and metals executive-search practice is closely aligned with my international leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across mining, natural resources and energy-transition environments where institutional trust, responsible development and coordinated execution are central to performance. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
